title: Finn.no Property Scraper
description: Scrape homes for sale listings from Finn.no. Use the default search page or provide a filtered Finn search URL. Every listing is saved with all fields Finn publishes in the search payload, so no listing page is opened.

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: A Finn homes-for-sale search URL. Use this for exact site-side filters such as area, price, ownership type, or listing status.

keyword.title: Keyword filter
keyword.description: Optional text filter matched against listing titles, addresses, property type, ownership type, and neighbourhood name.

location.title: Location filter
location.description: Optional text filter matched against the location or address text already visible on Finn pages.

results_wanted.title: Maximum number of listings
results_wanted.description: The maximum number of dataset items to save.

max_pages.title: Maximum number of search pages
max_pages.description: Safety cap for paginated search result pages.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy is recommended for consistent access. Residential proxies are the most reliable option for larger runs.
